title: 第14章 七武海有八个人应该很正常吧
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

入夜，茫茫大海上。

林北、悠悠、惠惠，再加上路飞和索隆，五个人围坐在甲板上，互相分享着今天的遭遇。

当索隆得知，把海军基地炸上天的居然是惠惠那个小不点，整个人愣了足有半分钟。

尤其是在得知林北他们来自异世界后，索隆就更加感到不可思议了。

“原来如此……难怪有那种离谱的魔法。”

“哼哼，现在知道吾的厉害了吧！”

惠惠双手叉腰，一脸得意。

因为明天就打算返回阿克塞尔，所以林北决定，趁这个难得的机会，先开一场宴会。

结果却是……

林北负责做饭，林北负责洗碗，林北负责打扫，其他人负责吃喝玩乐。

“为什么！为什么又是我！”

路飞正以惊人的速度往嘴里塞肉：“因为林北做的饭最好吃嘛！”

悠悠小心翼翼地举手：“林北先生，需要帮忙吗？”

索隆十分不解：这小哥明明看起来蛮可靠的，为什么会上路飞的船？

当天边泛起鱼肚白，一夜的狂欢终于结束，而他们也看到了另一片陆地。

为了感谢路飞和索隆昨天在海军基地帮忙吸引走了一半兵力，林北决定将船上唯一的救生船送给他们。

索隆直到这时候才弄清楚林北和路飞的关系。

“原来路飞不是你的船长？”

“不是啊。”

“你也不是这艘船的厨师？”

“不是啊。不如说，路飞只是我偶然遇到的客人才对。”

林北把和路飞相遇的经过简单说了一遍。

索隆的表情逐渐凝固。

“可恶啊……我是因为看到这艘船上有你这样靠谱的家伙，才在宴会上答应路飞入伙的。”

“呃……”

“所以说，我所在的海贼团，除了这个白痴船长，什么都没有，对吧？”

“呃……”

“算了，毕竟都答应他了。喂！路飞！你到底要搬多少吃的上船？给人家留点啊！”

“没关系的！林北说把食物都给我们了！”

“抱歉，我家的笨蛋船长给你添了这么多麻烦。说起来，你这是打算回另一个世界了？”

“嗯。虽然才来这里几天，但总感觉比工作了一年还要疲惫。我打算回去休息一段时间。”

“异世界啊……到现在还是觉得不可思议。”

索隆伸出手。

“那就有机会再见了，祝你武运昌隆。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At night, on the vast sea.

Lin Bei, Youyou, Megumin, plus Luffy and Zoro, the five of them sat around on the deck, sharing today's experiences with each other.

When Zoro learned that it was Megumin who blew up the naval base, he was stunned for half a minute.

Especially after learning that Lin Bei and the others came from a different world, Sauron felt even more incredible.

"I see... No wonder there is such outrageous magic."

"Humph, now you know how powerful I am!"

Megumin put her hands on her hips and looked proud.

Because he planned to return to Axel tomorrow, Lin Bei decided to take advantage of this rare opportunity to hold a banquet first.

The result is...

Lin Bei is responsible for cooking, Lin Bei is responsible for washing dishes, Lin Bei is responsible for cleaning, and the others are responsible for eating, drinking and having fun.

"Why! Why me again!"

Luffy was stuffing meat into his mouth at an alarming speed: "Because Lin Bei's cooking is the most delicious!"

Youyou raised her hand cautiously: "Mr. Lin Bei, do you need help?"

Zoro was very puzzled: This guy obviously seemed quite reliable, why would he get on Luffy's ship?

When the sky turned white, the night of carnival finally ended, and they also saw another piece of land.

In order to thank Luffy and Zoro for helping to attract half of the troops at the naval base yesterday, Lin Bei decided to give them the only lifeboat on the ship.

Zoro didn't figure out the relationship between Lin Bei and Luffy until this moment.

"So Luffy isn't your captain?"

"No."

"You're not the ship's cook either?"

"No. It's better to say that Luffy is just a guest I met by chance."

Lin Bei briefly told the story of how he met Luffy.

Zoro's expression gradually solidified.

"Damn it... I agreed to join Luffy at the banquet because I saw a reliable guy like you on this ship."

"Uh..."

"So, the pirate group I belong to has nothing but this idiot captain, right?"

"Uh..."

"Forget it, I agreed to him after all. Hey! Luffy! How much food do you want to carry on the boat? Leave some for others!"

"It's okay! Lin Bei said he gave us all the food!"

"I'm sorry that my idiot captain has caused you so much trouble. Speaking of which, are you planning to return to another world?"

"Yes. Although I have only been here a few days, I still feel more exhausted than after working for a year. I plan to go back and rest for a while."

"It's a different world... I still find it incredible."

Zoro extended his hand.

"Then we'll have a chance to meet you again. I wish you good luck in martial arts."
